meta_title: P S Warren Plastering | Expert Plasterer Birmingham
meta_description: P S Warren Plastering in Birmingham offers expert internal and external plastering, rendering, and decorative finishes. Local family business with over 20 years' experience. Free quotes.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Free Quotes & Honest Advice
hero_subhead: From small repairs to full house renders, we deliver smooth, durable finishes that last. Same-week appointments available.
services_subhead: Whether it's a patch repair, skimming, rendering, or decorative work, we handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, flawless finishes on walls and ceilings. We repair damp patches, patch holes, and skim old surfaces ready for decorating. Results are crack-free and built to last.

services.title: Rendering & External Finishes
services.desc: Durable external renders protect your home and improve its appearance. We apply cement, silicone, and decorative finishes that withstand Birmingham's weather for years.

services.title: Damp Repair & Remedial Plastering
services.desc: Specialising in damp-damaged walls, we remove failed plaster, treat the cause, and apply damp-resistant finishes so the problem doesn't return.

services.title: Artex Removal & Textured Coatings
services.desc: Remove dated Artex safely and professionally, or apply modern textured finishes for visual interest. We handle asbestos testing and disposal where needed.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation & Dry-Lining
services.desc: Insulate and update interiors with professional plasterboard and dry-lining. Perfect for building partition walls, soundproofing, or upgrading old properties.

services.title: Decorative Finishes & Specialist Coatings
services.desc: Polished plaster, Venetian effects, and lime finishes add character to period homes and contemporary spaces. Bespoke work tailored to your vision.

about_pullquote: Honesty and workmanship speak louder than fancy marketing.
about_para_1: P S Warren Plastering was founded over 20 years ago in Rednal, Birmingham. Starting with residential work, we've grown to handle everything from small repairs to large-scale commercial renders. Every member of our team is trained to our standards, and we pride ourselves on turning up on time, doing the job right, and finishing clean.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals. We listen to what you need, give honest advice about what's possible, and stick to our quotes. Whether you're a homeowner dealing with a damp wall or a builder managing a new-build project, you can expect the same professionalism and attention to detail every time.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with rising damp in our Victorian terrace. P S Warren came out, explained exactly what was causing it, and the render work they did has solved it completely. Two years on and no sign of it coming back. Brilliant job.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed the whole house skimmed after removing old wallpaper. They turned up on time, got stuck in, and didn't leave a mess. The finish is perfect — smooth as anything. Fair price and no messing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah P.

reviews.text: Called them for an emergency patch on a cracked ceiling where water had got in. Same day appointment, identified the leak, sorted the plaster, and gave advice on the underlying problem. No faffing, no overcharging. Exactly what you want from a tradesperson.
reviews.author: David H.

address_sub: Serving all of Birmingham and surrounding areas including Rednal, Harborne, Moseley, and beyond.
